results.title: A Danish Christmas
results.overview: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well.

results.title: My Kind of Christmas
results.overview: When ambitious assistant Lindsay must track down the season’s most sought-after toy to land a long-awaited promotion, she teams up with handsome widowed dad Erik on the same quest for his daughter. But as their practical mission turns into a heartwarming holiday journey, she’s forced to choose between the career she’s always chased and the unexpected joy of love, family, and Christmas magic!

results.title: As You Were
results.overview: In this loose homage to Steve Martin's "L.A. Story", Harris is a young man figuring his life out in New York City. Muddled relationships and struggles with commitment and change leave Harris confused and stuck in an unhappy status quo, struggling to figure out which direction to take his life. Through the help of new connections and New York City itself speaking to him, Harris is able to start to change his life for the better.

results.title: Traços de Fuga
results.overview: Diana retreats into drawing and music to escape the chaos of her home. Each page of her notebook becomes an extension of the emotions she cannot bring herself to say out loud. But when even the smallest moments of peace are interrupted, Diana realizes that mentally escaping may no longer be enough to cope with the reality she lives in.

results.title: Gnomes
results.overview: A trip to a road side grave turns into a whirl of emotions as two people struggle to process the loss of a loved one.

results.title: DOUEN
results.overview: Sania, a first-generation Trinidadian American, is haunted by mischievous Douens and must confront the dark secrets and generational trauma buried within her family before the past claims her future.

results.title: The Black Sheep
results.overview: When her troubled younger brother bursts into her home covered in blood and carrying a bag of stolen cash, a woman must decide whether to save him or finally let him answer for his actions.

results.title: Target: Captain Black!
results.overview: Once, he was their most trusted agent. Now, they hunt him.

results.title: Jeepers Capers
results.overview: A musical caper about a grocery store clerk named Jules and the stolen jewels in a jar of capers that might be his ticket to Hollywood. Set in a reimagining of the 1930s that only ever existed in cinema and dreams.

results.title: Almost Cupid
results.overview: To get his wings, a newly hired cupid must choose between doing the job and honouring free will after being assigned to save a toxic relationship that shouldn't exist.

results.title: Touken Ranbu the Stage: Hiden Tsuki to Taiyou to Hoshiboshi yo
results.original_title: 舞台『刀剣乱舞』陽伝 月と太陽と星々よ

results.title: Altera Partem
results.overview: Adam and two other men find themselves trapped in the hold of a ship. While the prisoners desperately search for a way out, the discovery of a strange breach in the wall will upend each of their beliefs.

results.title: I promise I won't bore you.
results.original_title: I promise I won't bore you.
results.overview: Failing birthday clown and cam-star Mary wades through the messy world of T4T dating after being voted out from her polycule.

results.title: The Wronged of Juiced
results.overview: Gus sees a boy drinking juice. It is not the same as he remembers.

results.title: Plan B
results.overview: When a hippie dealer and his pregnant, latina girlfriend find themselves transporting more than just mushrooms in the back of their car, they will either grow together or apart as new parents.

results.title: Summer's End
results.overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

results.title: Max
results.overview: During World War II, in a sealed room, a brutal psychological duel unfolds between Jean Moulin, the leader of the French Resistance, and Klaus Barbie, the Chief of the Gestapo.

results.title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
results.original_title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
results.overview: "Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down" is a documentary film about British social policy. The focus is on the political struggle against neoliberal austerity policies, which have their origins in the hated Thatcher government.  The film features the former socialist MP Dave Nellist, who is now the national chair of the Trade Unionist & Socialist Coalition and Hannah Sell, the general secretary of the Socialist Party. The film features a local election campaign in the miners' town of Nuneaton, students campaigning against an increase in tuition fees and refuse workers from Birmingham striking against massive cuts to their wages.
